## 待测试功能

### 1. EvaluationExecutionService 异步生成状态管理
- 文件：`platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/EvaluationExecutionService.java`
- 新增 `generateStatusMap`（ConcurrentHashMap<String, EvaluationExecutionStatusDTO>）和 `generateStatusTimestamps`
- 新增 `generateResultAsync(Long evaluationId, Long executionSessionId)`：
  - 构建 status=RUNNING 的 EvaluationExecutionStatusDTO 存入 generateStatusMap（key = evaluationId:executionSessionId）
  - 调用 asyncEvaluationExecutor.generateResultAsync 异步执行
  - 返回 RUNNING 状态的 DTO
- 新增 `generateGenerateStatus(Long evaluationId, Long executionSessionId)`：
  - 从 generateStatusMap 按 key=evaluationId:executionSessionId 查询
  - 不存在时抛 EVALUATION_EXECUTION_STATUS_NOT_FOUND
  - 存在时返回状态 DTO
- cleanupStaleStatuses 同时清理 generateStatusMap

### 2. AsyncEvaluationExecutor.generateResultAsync
- 文件：`platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/AsyncEvaluationExecutor.java`
- 新增 `@Async generateResultAsync(Long evaluationId, Long executionSessionId, Map<String, EvaluationExecutionStatusDTO> generateStatusMap)`：
  - 调用 evaluationResultGenerateService.generate(evaluationId, executionSessionId)
  - 成功后将 key=evaluationId:executionSessionId 的状态更新为 COMPLETED
  - 异常时将状态更新为 FAILED

### 3. EvaluationSessionController 异步轮询接口
- 文件：`platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/controller/EvaluationSessionController.java`
- `POST /api/evaluations/{id}/session/{sessionId}/generate`：改为调用 generateResultAsync，返回 ApiResponse<EvaluationExecutionStatusDTO>（status=RUNNING）
- 新增 `GET /api/evaluations/{id}/session/{sessionId}/generate/status`：调用 generateGenerateStatus 返回生成状态 DTO
